name: JoomPulse
description: JoomPulse gives you instant access to MercadoLivre Brazil's marketplace data through natural language queries. Analyze product listings, categories, sellers, pricing trends, reviews, and keywords — all powered by a structured data warehouse. Whether you're doing competitive research, category analysis, or tracking listing performance, JoomPulse translates your questions into precise data insights without writing a single line of SQL. Built for e-commerce teams and analysts who need fast, reliable answers from Brazil's largest online marketplace.

_published_faq.name: How do I add JoomPulse to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add JoomPulse to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://joompulse.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the JoomPulse MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: JoomPulse provides these MCP tools: find_product_sources, list_resources, query_cubejs_meli, query_cubejs_shopee, and read_resource.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to JoomPulse?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to JoomPulse in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
JoomPulse requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
JoomPulse is developed by JoomPulse. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
